narration:0:1460475001:0.text: These days, thanks to your efforts, nearly everyone in Sal'thorin has heard of the clinic—and your uncanny ability to cure just about anything.
narration:0:1460475001:0.source_cn: 时至今日，随着你的努力，萨洛克兰的病患们几乎无人不知医...

narration:1:1460475002:0.text: Today, both Xera and Indris drop by unexpectedly. Looks like they've got something to discuss...
narration:1:1460475002:0.source_cn: 今日，席蕾和因度厄突然来到了医馆，似乎有事想要商量……
